title: One-step Green Synthesis of Eco-friendly Novel N-P Synergistic Flame Retardant for Cotton Fabric
authors: Fengxiu Zhang; Ying Liao; Yu Chen; Yi Lu; Caiyan Wan; Guangxian Zhang
journal: Research Square author preprint v1, posted 25 June 2021
source_version_equivalence_status: Final journal numerical equivalence unverified; mandatory future source-wide version alias/reuse hold
composition: Source describes plain cotton fabrics, 100%, purchased from Chaotianmen Market in Chongqing, China; yarn and thread specifications not given
sample_state: FRC3, 40 wt% APGDPE bath, 20.8% weight gain, 0 laundering cycles
washing_state: Initial after preparation running-water rinse and oven drying; 0 durability laundering cycles
treatment_chemistry: Ammonium salt 1,3-propylene glycol diphosphate ester (APGDPE), with dicyandiamide catalyst
treatment_method: Synthesize APGDPE from 1,3-propylene glycol (0.100 mol, 7.765 g) and phosphoric acid (0.200 mol, 23.059 g) at 130 °C for 3 h with magnetic stirring; continuously add urea (0.200 mol, 12.012 g), heat at 170 °C for 2.5 h, purify with absolute ethanol, filter and oven-dry at 60 °C; yield approximately 88%. Dissolve APGDPE in distilled water to a 40 wt% bath and add dicyandiamide catalyst, whose amount is not reported. Immerse cotton at 70 °C for 40 min using a 1:20 fabric-mass to bath-volume ratio; pad through a nip to 120% wet pickup, cure at 180 °C for 5 min using an automatic continuous backing machine, rinse with running water and dry at 60 °C for 1 h. No additional precleaning or conditioning protocol is stated.
TGA_instrument: TG209F3, source manufacturer wording Germany Nets
TGA_specimen_preparation: Aliquot of the initial 40 wt% APGDPE-treated cotton fabric identified in the TG analysis prose. Sample mass, pan, gas flow, cutting or grinding and additional conditioning are not reported. KBr pellets belong to FTIR, not TGA.
source_material_form_TGA_raw: Control cotton and 40% APGDPE treated cotton fabrics; Figure 5 and Table 6
LOI_method: M606B digital oxygen index apparatus, Qingdao Shanfang Instrument Co., Ltd.; ASTM D2863-2000
LOI_specimen_preparation: Same initial FRC3 cotton fabric, 0 laundering cycles. LOI specimen dimensions, repeat count and uncertainty are not reported. The 35 cm × 8 cm dimensions belong to the vertical flame test.
TG_locator: Table 6, PDF p 11; TG analysis pp 9–10 explicitly identifies 40% APGDPE-treated cotton and defines T5%, T10%, Tmax and R800
LOI_locator: Table 2, PDF p 7, weight gain 20.8%, 0 LCs; FRC3 label and bath mapping in Table 1 p 5; own LOI method p 4
conditions_locator: Experimental section pp 3–5: substrate, APGDPE synthesis, finishing, TG and LOI methods
source_location: Complete official 21-page author preprint PDF; pp 3–5 methods and Table 1; pp 6–7 own measured LOI and Table 2; pp 9–11 TG definitions/data and Table 6; Figure 5 p 19 inspected for consistency. Original PDF pixels inspected for methods and Tables 2/6; no graph-estimated values.
pairing_evidence: Table 1 maps FRC3 to 40 wt% APGDPE bath and 20.8% weight gain. Table 2 supplies its measured zero-wash LOI 44.5. TG analysis p 9 explicitly identifies the treated cotton of Figure 5/Table 6 as 40% APGDPE-treated fabric. A separate FRC3-50 LCs state is named elsewhere and is not paired with initial TG.
source_numeric_evidence_description: Original preprint Table 2 measured LOI and Table 6 T5%, T10%, maximum degradation-rate Tmax, Rmax and residue at 800 °C; TG prose explicitly expands all definitions and corroborates values
limitations: Actual author preprint v1, not journal-verified. Final DOI 10.1007/s10570-021-04049-5 remains related version only with a mandatory future alias/reuse hold; exact final numerical equivalence has not been established. One prepared state is represented by two atmosphere conditions. Dicyandiamide catalyst dosage, initial fabric cleaning, TG aliquot mass/pan/flow and TG/LOI replication and conditioning are not stated. Control LOI is only about 18.0% and is held under the exact-number criterion. FRC1, FRC2 and all post-laundering LOI states lack matching TG. FRC2 after 30 cycles is 30.0 in prose but 30.3 in Table 2, retained as a held conflict. Table 3 contains literature comparators and is not new evidence. Cone calorimetry residues/CVs, FTIR KBr preparation and vertical-test dimensions are not transferred to TG or LOI. T5 is explicitly the 5% mass-loss point, and Tmax is explicitly maximum degradation-rate temperature; no onset or uncertainty is inferred.
